problem: Lets owners of other Apple Watch models turn on the Hermès watch faces, which are normally limited to certain devices. It is for tinkerers who sideload the app onto a paired iPhone and Watch.

stack.frontend: SwiftUI apps for Apple Watch (HermesEnabler2) and iPhone (HermesCompanion)
stack.backend: Objective-C and Swift on-device code (BQCore), WatchConnectivity for iPhone-Watch messaging, C tests
stack.database: — (uses plist files such as MGDefaults.plist and MGOffsets.plist; app also keeps backups)
stack.deploy: Sideloaded IPA (via Sideloadly on macOS or WatchBridge on Windows) or built with Xcode; supports watchOS 27.0 to 27.3 beta 1

whatsNew: It changes device capability values (MobileGestalt-style settings) on the Watch itself so that restricted watch faces appear on unsupported models. It includes backup and recovery checks, and a Python layout test.
